quarterly_data.quarter: Accelink press release: From 3.2T to 6.4T NPO: Accelink Redefines the "Optical (09-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Accelink released a new-generation 6.4T NPO (near-packaged optics) optical engine, debuted at CIOE 2026 for next-generation AI scenarios. Design: a transceiver-integrated silicon photonic PIC supporting 32x200G parallel channels, a linear direct-drive EIC, 2.5D Flip-Chip packaging with multi-channel fiber-array optical coupling, and a pluggable Socket interface; the OE optical engine is paired with an ELSFP external light source and an FMU-Shuffle fiber management unit as an end-to-end NPO solution. The company says this follows what it calls the industry's first full-system verification of a 3.2T silicon photonic single-mode NPO in March 2026, and argues NPO is a more balanced path than CPO because it keeps short electrical links and low power while staying maintainable and drawing on the mature optical-module supply chain. Exhibit only; no customers, volumes or availability date stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 6.4T NPO, 32x200G; 3.2T NPO full-system verification in March 2026
